annotations.title: Evaluate a batch of x402 payments (read-only, never signs)

description: transaction scope. Call this when an agent might pay several times in one turn and you want one policy decision covering all of them. Verdict is pay | review | do_not_pay per item, in input order, with reason codes — so the agent can stop at the first refusal rather than discovering it after three payments. Read-only, holds no keys, never signs. Cheaper and more consistent than calling evaluate_mcp_payment in a loop: same policy, one round trip. Fails closed: do not invent authority — a missing policy, identity, cost or evidence is a refusal, never a default.
name: evaluate_batch
